item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json,work\\nreq=json.load(open('requests.json')); ev=json.load(open('evidence.json')); pol=json.load(open('policy.json'))\\na=work.evaluate(req[0],ev,pol); assert a=={'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['S1','X1'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']},a\\nassert work.evaluate(req[1],ev,pol)=={'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['D1'],'unknowns':[]}\\nr={'claim':'c','conditions':{'x':1,'z':2}}; p={'required_conditions':['z','x'],'require_verified':True}; e=[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':{'b':2,'a':1},'conditions':{'x':1,'z':2},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':{'a':1,'b':2},'conditions':{'x':1,'z':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']},{'source':'unverified','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'x':1,'z':2},'verified':False},{'source':'withdrawn','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'x':1,'z':2},'verified':True,'withdrawn':True},{'source':'mismatch','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'x':1,'z':3},'verified':True}]\\nbefore=copy.deepcopy((r,e,p)); got=work.evaluate(r,e,p); assert got=={'status':'supported','value':{'a':1,'b':2},'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]},got; assert (r,e,p)==before\\nassert work.evaluate({'claim':'c','conditions':{}},e,p)=={'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['x','z']}\\nprint('checks passed')\"]}"}
